<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1000
<color=black>Toughness: </color>720 + 4400 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium
<color=black>Traits: </color>Immune to Chill and Freeze. Vulnerable to Deep Chill.</color>

zombies.name: <u>Megazubarão Biônico Domado</u>
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Few know the exact location of the raging Cherry Volcano, but Dr. Zomboss eventually found it and brought forth an ancient Cerasocetus. A brave knight took on the task of taming it, and since then, deafening explosions have constantly echoed through the doctor's ranks.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Harnessing the fury of the ancient giant whale, it leaps into the frontline, infusing Explosive Cherries with devastating power.

<color=black>Projectile Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>300 (Cherry)
1000 (Explosive Cherry)
<color=black>Damage: </color>300 (Non-bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color>48000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium; Fast when Enraged
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to freeze and stuns.
<color=black>•</color> Starts in a Calm state upon entering the field, and thereafter switches between this state and the Enraged state every 10s.
<color=black>•</color> When entering the Enraged state, it ignores plants and leaps forward 3 tiles.
<color=black>•</color> Every 0.5s, depending on its current state, it receives 1 corresponding projectile as fire support in a random lane.
<color=black>Calm State: </color>Fires 4 Cherries every 2s.
<color=black>Enraged State: </color>Movement speed is doubled. Fires 4 Explosive Cherries every 1s. Furthermore, before the zombie's Explosive Cherry deals direct or splash damage, it applies the "weakened" effect. Each stack of "weakened" lasts 15s, stacking up to 100 times. Each stack increases damage taken by 3%, and causes plants to lose HP equal to 0.3% of the projectile's attack power when hit by explosive cherry explosions.</color>

zombies.name: Zumbi Cronoz Celestial
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After being flattened and blown round countless times by spacetime turbulence, Astro Bucknut-copter Zombie finally brought back another version of himself from an alternate dimension. "Excuse me, why would you rather bring your alternate self here instead of going to the alternate dimension to eat brains?" Well now, this parallel version of him is helping by drawing fire away from him. He can eat more brains this way!</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Summons an alternate self to step forward and draw fire, while he himself sneaks in the air to wreak havoc.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 6000 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow; Alternate Self is Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color>Spawns a spacetime alternate self in its lane upon entering the field
<color=black>Main Body: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to Blover effects.
<color=black>•</color> While in the air, reduces the attack power of plants in a 3x3 area by 90%.
<color=black>•</color> When shot down, randomly teleports within a 3x3 area and gains a Type 1 armor with 2000 Toughness.
<color=black>Alternate Self: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to damage, movement speed ×3.
<color=black>•</color> Disappears immediately when shot down, blown away, or moved to the second column from the left of the map.
<color=black>Weakness: </color>Thorn-nut, Umbrella Thorn, Obsidian Tall-nut</color>

zombies.name: Zumbi Cavaleiro Negro Blindado
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>"This is unfair! Football is a contact sport! Am I really being penalized just for tackling too hard?" Zumbi Cavaleiro Negro Blindado grumbled indignantly. "Oh, certainly not. It was your horse that committed the foul; you may continue to participate in the match."</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Charges at plants riding a cursed steed in iron armor.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000 + 6000 (Type 2)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast; Extremely Fast when Charging
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback.
<color=black>•</color> Rides a steed that crushes plants.
<color=black>•</color> Enters by charging; upon hitting a plant, applies [0.05 × (Plant HP + Toughness) / 2] curse stacks to that plant. Then advances steadily, applying [0.01 × (Plant HP + Toughness) / 2] curse stacks when crushing.
<color=black>•</color> When the steed is defeated, dismounts, fully restores HP, and transforms into a Giga Football Zombie.</color>

zombies.name: Zumbi Cavaleiro Negro Abissal Blindado
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Equipped with a powerful, long-range Gatling gun, and clad in tough football gear for himself and his mount, Zumbi Cavaleiro Negro Abissal Blindado bought his knighthood with three brain combo meals. Using his flag to command and coordinate with his comrades, he is fully armed from body to name. "Perhaps we should give him a simpler name, like Tank," Dr. Zomboss remarked.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Advances steadily riding a cursed steed in iron armor, summoning his subordinates to attack when the situation turns unfavorable.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>80x6/1.5s
<color=black>Toughness: </color>4500 + 9000 (Type 2)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback.
<color=black>•</color> Rides a steed that crushes plants.
<color=black>•</color> When crushing, applies [0.01 × (Plant HP + Toughness) / 2] curse stacks. When base HP falls below 50%, summons a column of Zumbi Cavaleiro Negro Blindados. When the steed is defeated, dismounts, fully restores HP, and transforms into a Buckshot Commando Zombie.</color>

zombies.name: Zumbi Terror-da-Corte
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Zumbi Terror-da-Corte is practically the busiest zombie in the graveyard. She participates in chess matches between the Striker and the Archduke, plays the Man in the Iron Mask in the weekly medieval opera performances, serves as the center for the basketball team, and disguises herself as a horned devil to scare the Imp Zombies running around by the river. The rest of her time is spent mending the clothes she tore during these activities.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Can throw cursed Jack-in-the-Boxes from a distance.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>720 + 4400 (Type 1)
<color=black>Traits: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Her Jack-in-the-Box cannot be attracted by magnets.
<color=black>•</color> Has a small chance of self-detonation after a short period of time, but a higher probability of throwing it at the last column of plants.
<color=black>•</color> When it self-detonates, it triggers a Jack-in-the-Box explosion, but the bomb box only deals 1000 physical damage when thrown. Either way, the bomb applies [10% × (Plant HP + Toughness) / 2] curse stacks to plants caught in the explosion or Umbrellas that have deflected the bomb.</color>

zombies.name: Elefante Zumbi da Guerra
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>After comprehensively considering the graveyard's size and material supplies, Dr. Zomboss decided that Elefante Zumbi da Guerras should be deployed in squads of at most three. However, the Striker and the Archduke raised objections, arguing that three elephants are simply not enough for them to play a game of Chinese chess.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Guards the General and Commander until death.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>18000
<color=black>Damage: </color>1800
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Slow
<color=black>Traits: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Only appears in Flag waves.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback and being hypnotized.
<color=black>•</color> Regardless of where it comes from, takes damage on behalf of the Giga Football Striker and Archduke Deathrider.
<color=black>•</color> Every 12th attack causes a crush, pushing non-mini-boss zombies at its feet forward by 0.74 tiles.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers: </color>
1. Spawns in groups of 3
2. For each one present on the field, all Mini-boss Zombies gain 100 DR Value</color>

zombies.name: Brigada de Zumbis Metralhervilhas Blindado
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Four Giga Football-nut Zombie pooled a year's worth of salary to buy and modify this extended motorized sled. Although its previous owner was quite skilled in ice dancing, rather than performing the 'Dance of the Little Swans', they now only intend to perform the 'Four Heavenly Kings' for the plants.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Delivers a squad of 4 Buckshot Commando Zombies to the battlefield.

<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>3000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium
<color=black>Traits: </color>Immune to knockback. Ignores plants.
<color=black>•</color> Loses HP equal to 1% of its Toughness every 0.1 seconds.
<color=black>•</color> Instantly dies upon reaching the fourth column and to its left, spawning 4 Buckshot Commando Zombies upon death.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
1. Now has immunity to Freeze and Butter
2. Now enters the battlefield rapidly, but its speed gradually decreases</color>

zombies.name: Zumbi All-Stars Blindado e Reforçado
zombies.introduce:
<align=left><size=36><color=black>Ever since Zumbi All-Stars Blindado e Reforçado was a kid, his biggest dream was to collect all the flags from his matches, enemies, and battles, and wear them as a way to show his power and skill. He still hasn't collected all the flags, but one thing is for sure: he's got quite a few of them, and each one carries a long story about how he obtained it.

-- Written by clarkstacks</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Rolls through gaps in the defenses and tears through plants with razor-sharp claws.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100 (bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color>3000 + 6000 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Has 80% knockback resistance. Bites apply Curse stacks equal to his attack power.
<color=black>•</color> After his first bite, performs a roll, moving forward 2.7 tiles while ignoring plants.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
1. Roll once immediately on appearance
2. Deal ×2 damage after rolling</color>

zombies.name: Zumbi Nóz-Rúgbi Blindado e Reforçado
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>What is the most important thing for learning how to roll? Talent, technique, or tireless practice day and night? "None of those!" Zumbi Nóz-Rúgbi Blindado e Reforçado gave the final answer: "What you need to learn how to roll is a head hard enough to withstand it!"</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>A stronger Football Acrobat Zombie who rallies his troops and launches attacks with his rolls.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200 (bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color>3000 + 12000 (Type 1)
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium Fast
<color=black>Traits: </color>
<color=black>•</color> Has 80% knockback resistance. Bites apply Curse stacks equal to his attack power.
<color=black>•</color> After his first bite, performs a roll, moving forward 2.9 tiles while ignoring plants, and summons a column of Zumbi All-Stars Blindado e Reforçados.
<color=black>Odyssey Modifiers:</color>
1. Roll once immediately on appearance
2. Deal ×2 damage after rolling</color>

zombies.name: Zumbinho Imbuído de Elementos
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>It is said that the armor of the Zumbinho Imbuído de Elementoss was made from leftover scraps carved from a statue. It is incredibly tough and possesses some kind of special protective effect. Most zombies dismiss it as nothing more than a story, but those Imps who choose to believe it will visit the sleeping Yeti de Rocha-Matriz and chip away at it, hoping to knock off a piece for themselves.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>When summoned by an Element-infused Gargantuar, gains abilities based on the summoner's appearance.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>200 (bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>1500</color>
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Medium
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Gains corresponding abilities based on the appearance of the summoner:
<color=red>• Flame-forged Imp:</color> Toughness ×2.
<color=blue>• Tide-tempered Imp:</color> Speed ×2.
<color=yellow>• Wind-charged Imp:</color> Attack damage ×2.
<color=green>• Soil-bound Imp:</color> Always come in twos.</color></color>

zombies.name: <u>Rei Necrotera</u>
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Deep within the jungle lies a century-old flower: its roots are connected to the Tree of Wisdom, its blazing azure flames can burn all things, and countless souls filled with burning desires are hidden within its body. At first, everyone dismissed it as nothing more than a legend, until the zombies truly discovered an endless black-and-yellow root that stretched beyond sight....</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Approaches in a budding form, carrying signs of life, only to reveal its sinister nature and harbinger of death upon blooming.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>100 (Non-bite)
<color=black>Toughness: </color>48000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Extremely Slow
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Mini-boss. Immune to chill, freeze, knockback and stuns.
<color=black>•</color> Ignores plants while moving. Enters the battlefield in Bud Form and periodically switches between Bud Form and Bloomed Form.
<color=black>•</color> While present, prevents the lawn from producing plant Fertilizer, and increases the number of projectiles required to remove Wisped to [245 + 5 × the cube root of its Toughness]. Upon death, removes Wisped from all plants.
<color=black>Bud Form: </color>Lasts 15s. Rei Necrotera is immune to damage in this form. Disables using plant Fertilizer on plants. For every [49 + the cube root of its Toughness] projectiles absorbed, drops a bag of plant Fertilizer, loses 3% max HP, retreats backward, and changes lanes.
<color=black>Bloomed Form: </color>Lasts 30s. Slightly recoils when attacked, with the distance increasing based on damage taken. Every 5s, produces one Zombie Fertilizer in the top-left corner of the lawn and sprays flames forward, damaging all plants within 6 tiles (excluding flying plants). Check the mechanics almanac for explanations on Wisped effect and Zombie Fertilizer mechanics.</color>

zombies.name: Chefão Alfa Chad Gigatônico (WIP)
zombies.introduce: NOTE: This zombie is a work in progress and will be finished in a future update.
zombies.info:
<color=red>NOTE: This zombie is a work in progress and will be finished in a future update.</color>

<color=black>Toughness: </color>90000
<color=black>Movement Speed: </color>Fast
<color=black>Traits:</color>
<color=black>•</color> Boss. Immune to chill, freeze, knockback, stuns, and lane-switching effects. Instantly kills any hypnotized zombies it touches and converts any plant it touches into a Giga Football-nut Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Enters from the right side of the field, planting 3 flags ahead of itself. Each flag spawns Football-themed zombies every 5 seconds up to 5 times.
<color=black>•</color> Upon reaching the second column, retreats back to the right side of the field and re-enters to plant flags again.</color>

zombies.name: Elefante Zumbi  Sombrio
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Volcano tours are the hottest attraction offered by the Zombie Travel Agency. Zombie elephants absolutely love soaking in sulfurous fumes or strolling through showers of sparks. The result is obvious: their darkened skin gives them a significantly higher success rate when being selected for the Giga Football forces.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Uses its tusks to quickly crush plants.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>1800 (non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>18000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 1 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback and hypnotization.</color>

zombies.name: Elefante Zumbi  do Terror
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>The War Elephants have grown tired of life in the Giga Football forces. Endless training, slaughter, betrayal, survival of the fittest... It no longer trusts any zombies, its own kind, or even fruit. The only thing it can rely on is the perfectly fitted bone helmet covering its face — a trophy obtained after betraying another of its kind.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Tramples plants during its assault and sends zombies deeper into the defensive line.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>3600 (non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>36000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 2 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback and hypnotization. Every 12th attack performs a crush attack, pushing non-boss zombies in front of it forward by 0.74 tiles.</color>

zombies.name: Elefante Zumbi  Carmesim
zombies.introduce: <align=left><size=36><color=black>Elefante Zumbi  Carmesim lets out an enraged roar and stomps the ground with all four feet, shaking the earth itself. After escaping the laboratory years ago, it not only rejoined the Giga Football forces, but grew into an elite war elephant and was equipped with specialized heavy armor. Yet the cactus spine it stepped on during that chaotic escape is still stuck in its foot to this day.</color>
zombies.info:
<size=36>Launches a devastating assault on the front lines, pushing troops forward and unleashing a powerful shockwave.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#4B0082>7200 (non-bite)</color>
<color=black>Toughness: </color><color=#4B0082>72000</color>
<color=black>Traits: </color><color=#4B0082>
<color=black>•</color> Tier 3 Evolved Zombie.
<color=black>•</color> Immune to knockback and hypnotization. Every 5th attack performs a crush attack, pushing non-boss zombies in front of it forward by 0.74 tiles and dealing area damage within a 1.5-tile radius.</color>
